node_executions.notes: User supplied Alpaca paper-account and Slack screenshots showing fragmented fills, repeated JWEL entries/exits, a $134.34 daily loss, a three-loss circuit halt, repeated halt notifications, and a health-check error. The user stopped the bot and removed the Railway deployment before repair work began.

Executable negative controls against deployed commit b7f8b0845162cc3a620de51fd1fc674c98f56235 reproduced enum-status mismatch, absent immediate bracket legs, non-idempotent retry behavior, broker-flat oversells, unconfirmed cancellation, persistent circuit-trigger recovery, halted-as-unhealthy duplication, and 10000% win-rate rendering.

Scoped the repair to Alpaca paper trading. Broker screenshots showed zero remaining positions and zero open orders after the stop. No broker, Railway, secret, deployment, or production-state mutation was performed by this run.

Primary cause: str(alpaca enum) produced values such as OrderStatus.FILLED while the portfolio manager compared only lowercase wire values, so fills and terminal states were missed. Contributing causes: the immediate bracket response was assumed to contain legs; submissions were retried without a stable client_order_id; parent/exit fills were accepted without bounded terminal confirmation; bracket cancellations were not proven before replacement exits; the internal quantity was trusted over broker quantity; a persistent loss trigger could time-transition into an entry-eligible state; circuit and health paths emitted the same condition; daily-summary rendering multiplied an already-percent value by 100.

Normalize SDK enums at the broker boundary; make submissions and replacements idempotent; fetch nested bracket state; require broker-confirmed fills, quantities, legs, cancellations, and flatness; eliminate competing exit orders; keep active risk triggers halted; emit circuit alerts only on transitions; separate operational health from financial halt state; correct percentage rendering; add pre-fix/post-fix regressions.

Attempt 1 implemented the core lifecycle, circuit, and notification safeguards. Final change review found that scale-outs still placed a sell while full-size bracket exits were live and that an unconfirmed manual-exit cancellation could restore a competing stop. Attempt 2 now confirms both bracket legs inactive before scale-out, restores one stop for the confirmed remainder, blocks on ambiguous cancellation, and handles cancellation losing the race to a complete fill.

Added focused stdlib-compatible lifecycle, circuit persistence, health-state, alert-transition, and summary-percent tests; extended paper-broker, circuit-recovery, and notification tests. The five locally executable focused suites pass 22 tests after the repair.

Compiled all modified production and test modules and ran whitespace/error checks over the reconstructed diffs. GitHub's first complete backend run passed 2,821 tests and exposed one stale pre-existing assertion that still classified a financial halt as an operational outage; the assertion was aligned with the new documented semantics. The rerun passed all 2,822 tests and the Python production-dependency audit. Governance validation also passed. The web dependency audit remains red on an unchanged frontend lockfile and is tracked as an unresolved repository-level blocker.
Wrote this execution record and its evidence bundle to the repository-designated .governance/evidence directory with canonical SHA-256 content hashes.

Agent-side state is 'tested', not 'verified'. Baseline negative controls fail; repaired focused suites, compileall, diff checks, governance validation, Python dependency audit, and the complete 2,822-test backend suite pass. The unchanged frontend lockfile fails its security audit, and independent UIE verification plus a real Alpaca sandbox integration run remain outstanding.
Repair is ready for a draft pull request and human review. The bot remains stopped; no merge, deployment, restart, or live-money action is part of this run.
